  {

      # names(lgca_covar_MI_tics_data[["missimp_TICs_catg_conti1.dat"]])

      names(lgca_covar_MI_tics_data[["missimp_TICs_catg_conti10.dat"]])
      
      ## step2: treat latent growth factors as observed vars
      # within covar
      ### 性别调节效应

      {
        pp_lgca <- mplusObject( 
          TITLE = glue(

          VARIABLE = glue(
            "usevar = 
  wfdms12 wfdms16 wfdms18 wfdms20 wfdms22

    ",
          
          
          MODELCONSTRAINT = 
            glue(
              "
!!! Model Equation of three-way moderation
! 
!Y = iY + b1X + b2W + b3Z + b4XW + b5XZ + b6WZ + b7XWZ + eY
!  = iY + (b1 + b4W + b5Z + b7WZ)*X + b2W + b3Z + b6WZ + eY
!  = iY + (b1 + b5Z) * X + (b4 + b7Z) W * X + b2W + b3Z + b6WZ + eY

! Range of W value
!
! min_wi = ({wvalue_i2_min})   max_wi = ({wvalue_i2_max})
! min_ws = ({wvalue_s2_min})   max_ws = ({wvalue_s2_max})

NEW( min_w max_w lo_z hi_z );

min_w = ({wvalue_i2_min});
!lo_w = w_mean - sqrt(w_var);   ! -1 SD below mean of W
!med_w = w_mean;   ! mean of W
!hi_w = w_mean + sqrt(w_var);   ! +1 SD below mean of W
max_w = ({wvalue_i2_max});

lo_z = 0;   ! low of Z
hi_z = 1;   ! high of Z

       

!!!!! XW_int→Y = (b4 + b7Z) W * X

!!! i on i * i
NEW (wiii0 wiii1);
wiii0 = b4i + b7i*lo_z;
wiii1 = b4i + b7i*hi_z;

!!! s on i * i
NEW (wiis0 wiis1);
wiis0 = b4s + b7s*lo_z;
wiis1 = b4s + b7s*hi_z;
!*
!!! s on i * s
NEW (wiss0 wiss1);

wiss1 = b4s + b7s*hi_z;

!!! s on s * i
NEW (wsis0 wsis1);
wsis0 = b4s + b7s*lo_z;
wsis1 = b4s + b7s*hi_z;

!!! s on s * s
NEW (wsss0 wsss1);
wsss0 = b4s + b7s*lo_z;
wsss1 = b4s + b7s*hi_z;
*!

!!!!! X→Y = (b1 + b4W + b5Z + b7WZ)*X

!!! i on i * i
NEW (
wiii0min wiii0max
wiii1min wiii1max
);

wiii0min = b1i + b4i*min_w + b5i*lo_z + b7i*min_w*lo_z;
!wiii0lo = b1i + b4i*lo_w + b5i*lo_z + b7i*lo_w*lo_z;
!wiii0mod = b1i + b4i*med_w + b5i*lo_z + b7i*med_w*lo_z;

wiii1min = b1i + b4i*min_w + b5i*hi_z + b7i*min_w*hi_z;
!wiii1lo = b1i + b4i*lo_w + b5i*hi_z + b7i*lo_w*hi_z;
!wiii1mod = b1i + b4i*med_w + b5i*hi_z + b7i*med_w*hi_z;
!wiii1hi = b1i + b4i*hi_w + b5i*hi_z + b7i*hi_w*hi_z;

!!! s on i * i
NEW (
wiis0min wiis0max
wiis1min wiis1max
);

wiis0min = b1s + b4s*min_w + b5s*lo_z + b7s*min_w*lo_z;
!wiis0lo = b1s + b4s*lo_w + b5s*lo_z + b7s*lo_w*lo_z;
!wiis0mod = b1s + b4s*med_w + b5s*lo_z + b7s*med_w*lo_z;
!wiis0hi = b1s + b4s*hi_w + b5s*lo_z + b7s*hi_w*lo_z; 
wiis0max = b1s + b4s*max_w + b5s*lo_z + b7s*max_w*lo_z;

wiis1min = b1s + b4s*min_w + b5s*hi_z + b7s*min_w*hi_z;
!wiis1lo = b1s + b4s*lo_w + b5s*hi_z + b7s*lo_w*hi_z;
!wiis1mod = b1s + b4s*med_w + b5s*hi_z + b7s*med_w*hi_z;
!wiis1hi = b1s + b4s*hi_w + b5s*hi_z + b7s*hi_w*hi_z;

!*
!!! s on i * s

!*
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

!!! X as focal antecedent variable
!!! (x-axis = xvalue, y = yvalue, legend = different level of moderator)
!!! merit: the trend of y / different pattern of slope.
!
!    X_LOW    3.701      0.023    163.034      0.000
!    X_HIGH   4.464      0.020    219.375      0.000

!JN_wiii = b1i + b3i*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of I2
!JN_wiis = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of I2
!JN_wiss = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of S2
!JN_wsis = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of I2

            "tech1 tech4 tech10 tech11 tech14 sampstat patterns stdyx;",
          
          SAVEDATA = glue(
            "FILE = pp_lgca_type12_pinc412_r_step2_cat_s_mod_s_MI_TICs_result.txt;
!SAVE = CPROB;"),
          
          PLOT =
            "type = plot3;",
          
          usevariables = colnames(lgca_covar_MI_tics_data), 
          rdata = lgca_covar_MI_tics_data,
          imputed = TRUE
        ) 
        
        # 构造新文件夹result_gmm路径 
        newdir <- file.path(here("interge_rela", "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22"))
        # 自动创建文件夹, recursive = TRUE, 覆盖原有文件夹
        if (!dir.exists(newdir)) {
          dir.create(newdir, recursive = TRUE)
        }
        # 检查目录是否创建成功
        if (!dir.exists(newdir)) {
          stop("目录创建失败，请检查路径和权限。")
        }
        # 设定工作目录
        setwd(newdir)   
        # 指定了要执行运算的模型, 即上面定义的包含有Mplus代码的模型    
        pp_lgca_fit <- mplusModeler(pp_lgca, 
                                    dataout = "pp_lgca_type12_pinc412_r_step2_cat_s_mod_s_MI_TICs.dat", 
                                    modelout = glue("pp_lgca_type12_pinc412_r_step2_cat_s_mod_s_MI_TICs.inp"),
                                    check = TRUE, run = TRUE, hashfilename = FALSE, quiet = FALSE)  
      } 
      
      ### 收入调节效应LRT检验(全都不显著)
    }
    
    
    ### 性别 * 标准差 对 均值 的调节效应做表
    # depression
    {
      library(dplyr)
      library(MplusAutomation)
      library(here)
      
      #Read all models for enumeration table
      #读取所有LPA模型结果文件夹中的所有.out文件
      here()
      filepath <- "C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/interge_rela/result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22/"
      
      ##### 读取所有模型结果
      ## i2i1
      output.cesd8.type12_i2i1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type12_sex12_r_step2_cat_i_mod_i_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## i2s1
      output.cesd8.type12_i2s1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type12_sex12_r_step2_cat_s_mod_i_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## s2i1
      output.cesd8.type12_s2i1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type12_sex12_r_step2_cat_i_mod_s_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## s2s1
      output.cesd8.type12_s2s1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type12_sex12_r_step2_cat_s_mod_s_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      
      ##### 制表模型结果
      ### i2i1
      # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
      model.result.type12_i2i1 <- output.cesd8.type12_i2i1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
            # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
            # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
            # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
            # W=0
            str_detect(param, "^(W)") & str_detect(param, "(0)$") ~ "XW0",
            str_detect(param, "0MIN$") ~ "X0MIN",
            str_detect(param, "0LO$") ~ "X0LO",
            str_detect(param, "0MOD$") ~ "X0MOD",
            str_detect(param, "0HI$") ~ "X0HI",
            str_detect(param, "0MAX$") ~ "X0MAX",
            # W=1
            str_detect(param, "^(W)") & str_detect(param, "(1)$") ~ "XW1",
            str_detect(param, "1MIN$") ~ "X1MIN",
            str_detect(param, "1LO$") ~ "X1LO",
            str_detect(param, "1MOD$") ~ "X1MOD",
            str_detect(param, "1HI$") ~ "X1HI",
            str_detect(param, "1MAX$") ~ "X1MAX",
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
        mutate(
          # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
          sort_group = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S1") ~ 1,
            predictor.var %in% c("I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,   
            predictor.var %in% c("SEX12") ~ 3,   
            # predictor.var %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
            # predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
            # predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
            # predictor.var %in% c("S2S1_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT") ~ 7
            predictor.var %in% c("XW_INT","XZ_INT","WZ_INT","XWZ_INT") ~ 4,
            predictor.var %in% c("XW0","XW1") ~ 5,
            predictor.var %in% c("X0MIN","X0LO","X0MOD","X0HI","X0MAX") ~ 6,        
            predictor.var %in% c("X1MIN","X1LO","X1MOD","X1HI","X1MAX") ~ 7,
          )
        ) %>% 
        # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
        arrange(sort_group) %>% 
        select(-sort_group)
      
      
      # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
      r2 <- output.cesd8.type12_i2i1[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
      I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
      S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]
      
      # 3. 提取模型拟合指数
      summaries <- output.cesd8.type12_i2i1[["summaries"]]
      AIC <- summaries$AIC_Mean[1]
      BIC <- summaries$BIC_Mean[1]
      CFI <- summaries$CFI_Mean[1]
      TLI <- summaries$TLI_Mean[1]
      RMSEA <- summaries$RMSEA_Mean[1]
      
      # 4. 创建拟合指数文本
      model.fit_text.type1 <- paste0("AIC=", sprintf("%.2f", AIC), 
                                     ",\n BIC=", sprintf("%.2f", BIC))
      
      # 5. 添加 Pseudo-R² 行和 Model fit index 行
      model.result.type12_i2i1 <- model.result.type12_i2i1 %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Pseudo-R²",
          I5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", I5_r2),
          S5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", S5_r2)
        ) %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Model fit index",
          I5.ON = model.fit_text.type1,
          S5.ON = model.fit_text.type1
        ) %>% 
        mutate(
          predictor.var.common = case_when(
            # predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ "Intercept",
            # predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4") ~ "Slope",
            # predictor.var %in% c("SEX12") ~ "SEX",

        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"

            str_detect(param, "0LO$") ~ "X0LO",
            str_detect(param, "0MOD$") ~ "X0MOD",

            str_detect(param, "1HI$") ~ "X1HI",
            str_detect(param, "1MAX$") ~ "X1MAX",

          ),

            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),

            # predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,

            # predictor.var %in% c("S2S1_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT") ~ 7
            predictor.var %in% c("XW_INT","XZ_INT","WZ_INT","XWZ_INT") ~ 4,

          )
        ) %>%

      # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square

Unstandardized coeffcients are presented. Standard errors in parentheses. All models were also adjusted for number of waves in which respondents 
participated(Friedman etal., 2025). The variance of the slope for positive marital quality is constrained to be 0 due to lack of variation over time. <br>\n", 
                               "\\+ p < 0.1, * p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001")),

    ######## 三维交互项
    
    ###### 为了聚焦斜率差异，通常将起点归一化或仅保留斜率趋势(参照Dawson 2006, 放弃)
    # 若XW0也达到0.1水平显著性时, 根据X0MIN、X0MAX绘制调节效应的简单斜率图，导出为png格式的代码；
    # 若XW0未达到0.1水平显著性时, 证明X在Z=0时不受W调节，无需绘图；
    # 若XW1也达到0.1水平显著性时, 根据X1MIN、X1MAX绘制调节效应的简单斜率图，导出为png格式的代码；
    # 若XW1未达到0.1水平显著性时, 证明X在Z=1时不受W调节，无需绘图。
    {
      
      
      library(tidyverse)
      library(stringr)
      
      # 1. 辅助函数：解析单元格 (保持不变)
      parse_cell <- function(cell_str) {
        if (length(cell_str) > 1) cell_str <- cell_str[1]
        if (is.na(cell_str)) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE))
        
        is_sig <- str_detect(cell_str, "[\\+\\*]")
        coef_part <- str_split(cell_str, "\n")[[1]][1]
        value_clean <- str_remove_all(coef_part, "[\\+\\*]")
        value <- as.numeric(value_clean)
        return(list(value = value, is_sig = is_sig))
      }
      
      # 2. 辅助函数：绘制简单斜率图 (保持风格不变)
      generate_interaction_plot <- function(slope_low, slope_high, intercept_main_effect, 
                                            x_label, y_label, title_suffix, filename) {
        
        # 定义预测变量 (X) 的范围
        x_vals <- c(-1, 1)
        
        # Low Group (W = 0 / MIN)
        # 注意：在三阶交互拆解中，这里的 intercept_main_effect 代表 W 的主效应
        # 如果无法确定 W 的主效应，传入 0，此时两条线将从同一点出发
        b0_low <- 0 
        y_low_start <- b0_low + slope_low * x_vals[1]
        y_low_end   <- b0_low + slope_low * x_vals[2]
        
        # High Group (W = 1 / MAX)
        # 只有当 W=1 时，才加上 W 的主效应带来的截距位移
        b0_high <- 0 + intercept_main_effect
        y_high_start <- b0_high + slope_high * x_vals[1]
        y_high_end   <- b0_high + slope_high * x_vals[2]
        
        plot_data <- data.frame(
          x = rep(x_vals, 2),
          y = c(y_low_start, y_low_end, y_high_start, y_high_end),
          Group = rep(c("W = 0 (Min)", "W = 1 (Max)"), each = 2)
        )
        
        p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Group, linetype = Group)) +
          geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
          geom_point(size = 3) +
          scale_color_manual(values = c("W = 0 (Min)" = "#377EB8", "W = 1 (Max)" = "#E41A1C")) +
          scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "longdash")) +
          labs(
            title = title_suffix, # 标题稍微简化，放在上面
            x = x_label, 
            y = y_label
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme_bw() +
          theme(
            legend.title = element_blank(),
            legend.position = "inside",
            legend.position.inside = c(.95, .95),
            legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
            legend.box.just = "right",
            legend.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            panel.grid = element_blank()
          )
        
        ggsave(filename, plot = p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
        message(paste("    -> Saved plot:", filename))
      }
      
      # 3. 主循环
      # 假设你的环境中已经有了这些数据框
      data_list <- list(
        type12_i2i1 = model.result.type12_i2i1,
        type12_i2s1 = model.result.type12_i2s1,
        type12_s2i1 = model.result.type12_s2i1,
        type12_s2s1 = model.result.type12_s2s1
      )
      
      for (name in names(data_list)) {
        df <- data_list[[name]]
        message(paste("Processing Dataset:", name))
        
        # --- 预处理：提取关键行的位置 ---
        # 这里的逻辑是：不管显著不显著，先把数值取出来备用
        # 注意：必须加上 tryCatch 或者判断行是否存在，防止数据缺失报错
        
        get_val <- function(var_name, col_name) {
          row <- df %>% filter(predictor.var == var_name)
          if (nrow(row) == 0) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE))
          return(parse_cell(row[[col_name]]))
        }
        
        # 尝试寻找 W 的主效应行 (用于绘图截距位移)
        # 由于不知道你的 W 变量具体叫什么 (可能是 S1, S2, 或者 W), 这里暂时设为 0
        # 如果你知道 W 对应的变量名（例如 "S2"），可以将下一行改为: w_main_eff_val <- get_val("S2", col_name)$value
        w_main_eff_val <- 0 
        
        # --- 遍历两个结果列：I5.ON (截距) 和 S5.ON (斜率) ---
        cols_to_check <- c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")
        
        # 提取名称的最后两个字母作为 x_label, 并大写
        x_label_suffix <- toupper(str_sub(name, -2, -1))
        
        for (col in cols_to_check) {
          col_label <- ifelse(col == "I5.ON", "I5 (Intercept)", "S5 (Slope)")
          
          # 1. 检查三阶交互 XWZ_INT 是否显著
          xwz_res <- get_val("XWZ_INT", col)
          
          filename_prefix <- file.path(here("interge_rela", 
                                            "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22"))
          
          if (xwz_res$is_sig) {
            message(paste0("  [", col_label, "] Found Significant 3-Way Interaction: XWZ_INT"))
            
            # -----------------------------------------------------------
            # 分支 A: 检查 Z=0 时的调节效应 (XW0)
            # -----------------------------------------------------------
            xw0_res <- get_val("XW0", col)
            
            if (xw0_res$is_sig) {
              message(paste0("    -> Z=0 Sub-group: XW Interaction is significant. Generating plot..."))
              
              # 提取简单斜率: X0MIN (W=0) 和 X0MAX (W=1)
              slope_min <- get_val("X0MIN", col)$value
              slope_max <- get_val("X0MAX", col)$value
              
              # 绘图
              generate_interaction_plot(
                slope_low = slope_min, 
                slope_high = slope_max, 
                intercept_main_effect = w_main_eff_val,
                x_label = x_label_suffix, 
                y_label = str_split(col_label, " ")[[1]][1], # 提取 "I5" 或 "S5"
                title_suffix = paste0("Moderation by W when Z=0 (", name, "-", col, ")"),
                filename = paste0(filename_prefix, "/ThreeWay_Z0_", name, "_", col, ".png")
              )
            } else {
              message(paste0("    -> Z=0 Sub-group: XW Interaction NOT significant. Skipping."))
            }
            
            # -----------------------------------------------------------
            # 分支 B: 检查 Z=1 时的调节效应 (XW1)
            # -----------------------------------------------------------
            xw1_res <- get_val("XW1", col)
            
            if (xw1_res$is_sig) {
              message(paste0("    -> Z=1 Sub-group: XW Interaction is significant. Generating plot..."))
              
              # 提取简单斜率: X1MIN (W=0) 和 X1MAX (W=1)
              slope_min <- get_val("X1MIN", col)$value
              slope_max <- get_val("X1MAX", col)$value
              
              # 绘图
              generate_interaction_plot(
                slope_low = slope_min, 
                slope_high = slope_max, 
                intercept_main_effect = w_main_eff_val,
                x_label = x_label_suffix, 
                y_label = str_split(col_label, " ")[[1]][1], 
                title_suffix = paste0("Moderation by W when Z=1 (", name, "-", col, ")"),
                filename = paste0(filename_prefix, "/ThreeWay_Z1_", name, "_", col, ".png")
              )
            } else {
              message(paste0("    -> Z=1 Sub-group: XW Interaction NOT significant. Skipping."))
            }
            
          } else {
            # 三阶交互不显著，不进行后续操作
            # message(paste0("  [", col_label, "] XWZ_INT not significant."))
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    # 但为了对比 Z=0的XW与Z=1的XW，有必要将这四个简单斜率共同绘制在同一张图中，便于对比趋势，此时图例应该包含四条斜线，分别命名为：Z0WMIN, Z0WMAX, Z1WMIN, Z1WMAX。请问是否合理？
    # 未包含Z 和 W 的主效应，故简单斜率图有偏差(参照Dawson 2006, 放弃)。
    {
      library(tidyverse)
      library(stringr)
      
      # 1. 辅助函数：解析单元格
      parse_cell <- function(cell_str) {
        if (length(cell_str) > 1) cell_str <- cell_str[1]
        if (is.na(cell_str)) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE))
        
        is_sig <- str_detect(cell_str, "[\\+\\*]")
        coef_part <- str_split(cell_str, "\n")[[1]][1]
        value_clean <- str_remove_all(coef_part, "[\\+\\*]")
        value <- as.numeric(value_clean)
        return(list(value = value, is_sig = is_sig))
      }
      
      # 2. 辅助函数：绘制三维交互图 (四条线)
      generate_3way_plot <- function(s_z0_wmin, s_z0_wmax, s_z1_wmin, s_z1_wmax,
                                     x_label, w_label, y_label, title_suffix, filename) {
        
        # 定义 X 轴范围 (-1SD 到 +1SD)
        x_vals <- c(-1, 1)
        
        # --- 计算 Y 值 ---
        # 注意：为了简化展示斜率差异，假设中心截距为0。
        # 实际上，Z 和 W 的主效应会改变截距，但这里为了聚焦斜率差异，通常将起点归一化或仅保留斜率趋势
        
        # Z=0, W=MIN
        y_z0_wmin <- c(0 + s_z0_wmin * -1, 0 + s_z0_wmin * 1)
        
        # Z=0, W=MAX (假设 W 主效应带来的截距差异不在此展示，聚焦斜率)
        y_z0_wmax <- c(0 + s_z0_wmax * -1, 0 + s_z0_wmax * 1)
        
        # Z=1, W=MIN (假设 Z 主效应带来的截距差异不在此展示)
        y_z1_wmin <- c(0 + s_z1_wmin * -1, 0 + s_z1_wmin * 1)
        
        # Z=1, W=MAX
        y_z1_wmax <- c(0 + s_z1_wmax * -1, 0 + s_z1_wmax * 1)
        
        # --- 构建绘图数据框 ---
        plot_data <- data.frame(
          x = rep(x_vals, 4),
          y = c(y_z0_wmin, y_z0_wmax, y_z1_wmin, y_z1_wmax),
          # 定义分组标签
          Condition = rep(c(paste0("Z=0, W=Low", w_label),
                            paste0("Z=0, W=High", w_label),
                            paste0("Z=1, W=Low", w_label),
                            paste0("Z=1, W=High", w_label)
          ), each = 2),
          # 辅助列用于映射属性
          Z_Level = rep(c("Z=0", "Z=0", "Z=1", "Z=1"), each = 2),
          W_Level = rep(c("Low", "High", "Low", "High"), each = 2)
        )
        
        # ── 先定义四个条件标签 ────────────────────────
        lab_z0_low  <- paste0("Z=0, W=Low",  w_label)
        lab_z0_high <- paste0("Z=0, W=High", w_label)
        lab_z1_low  <- paste0("Z=1, W=Low",  w_label)
        lab_z1_high <- paste0("Z=1, W=High", w_label)
        
        labs_ordered <- c(lab_z0_low, lab_z0_high, lab_z1_low, lab_z1_high)
        
        # ── 颜色和线型 ────────────────────────────────
        color_values <- setNames(
          c("#A6CEE3", "#1F78B4", "#FB9A99", "#E31A1C"),
          labs_ordered
        )
        
        linetype_values <- setNames(
          c("solid", "longdash", "solid", "longdash"),
          labs_ordered
        )
        
        # --- 绘图 ---
        p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Condition, linetype = Condition)) +
          geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
          geom_point(size = 3) +
          
          scale_color_manual(values = color_values) +
          scale_linetype_manual(values = linetype_values) +
          
          labs(
            x = x_label,
            y = y_label
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme_bw() +
          theme(
            legend.title = element_blank(),
            legend.position = "inside",
            legend.position.inside = c(.95, .95),
            legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
            legend.box.just = "right",
            legend.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            panel.grid = element_blank()
          )
        
        ggsave(filename, plot = p, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300) # 稍微加宽一点以容纳图例
        message(paste(" -> Saved 3-way plot:", filename))
      }
      
      # 3. 主循环
      data_list <- list(
        type12_i2i1 = model.result.type12_i2i1,
        type12_i2s1 = model.result.type12_i2s1,
        type12_s2i1 = model.result.type12_s2i1,
        type12_s2s1 = model.result.type12_s2s1
      )
      
      for (name in names(data_list)) {
        df <- data_list[[name]]
        message(paste("Processing Dataset:", name))
        
        get_val <- function(var_name, col_name) {
          row <- df %>% filter(predictor.var == var_name)
          if (nrow(row) == 0) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE))
          return(parse_cell(row[[col_name]]))
        }
        
        cols_to_check <- c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")
        x_label_suffix <- toupper(str_sub(name, -2, -1)) # 提取最后两个字符作为标签
        w_label_suffix <- toupper(str_sub(name, -4, -3)) # 提取最后两个字符作为标签
        
        filename_prefix <- file.path(here("interge_rela", 
                                          "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22"))
        
        for (col in cols_to_check) {
          col_label <- ifelse(col == "I5.ON", "I5 (Intercept)", "S5 (Slope)")
          y_lab_simple <- str_split(col_label, " ")[[1]][1] # 提取 "I5" 或 "S5"
          
          # 1. 核心判定：仅检查三阶交互 XWZ_INT 是否显著
          xwz_res <- get_val("XWZ_INT", col)
          
          if (xwz_res$is_sig) {
            message(paste0(" [", col_label, "] Found Significant 3-Way Interaction: XWZ_INT"))
            
            # 2. 提取所有四个简单斜率
            slope_z0_min <- get_val("X0MIN", col)$value
            slope_z0_max <- get_val("X0MAX", col)$value
            slope_z1_min <- get_val("X1MIN", col)$value
            slope_z1_max <- get_val("X1MAX", col)$value
            
            # 3. 检查是否有缺失值 (防错)
            if (any(is.na(c(slope_z0_min, slope_z0_max, slope_z1_min, slope_z1_max)))) {
              message(" -> Warning: Missing slope values. Skipping plot.")
              next
            }
            
            # 4. 生成统一的三维交互图
            generate_3way_plot(
              s_z0_wmin = slope_z0_min,
              s_z0_wmax = slope_z0_max,
              s_z1_wmin = slope_z1_min,
              s_z1_wmax = slope_z1_max,
              x_label = x_label_suffix,
              w_label = w_label_suffix,
              y_label = y_lab_simple,
              title_suffix = paste0("3-Way Interaction: ", name, " on ", y_lab_simple),
              filename = paste0(filename_prefix, "/ThreeWay_Combined_EDU_", name, "_", y_lab_simple, ".svg")
            )
            
          } else {
            # message(paste0(" [", col_label, "] XWZ_INT not significant."))
          }
        }
      }
      
    }
    # 包含Z 和 W 的主效应(参照Dawson 2006, 放弃)
    {
      
      library(tidyverse)
      library(stringr)
      
      # 1. 辅助函数：解析单元格
      parse_cell <- function(cell_str) {
        # 确保输入是单个字符串，如果是向量取第一个（防错）
        if (length(cell_str) > 1) cell_str <- cell_str[1]
        
        # 处理 NA 情况
        if (is.na(cell_str)) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE))
        
        # 检测显著性
        is_sig <- str_detect(cell_str, "[\\+\\*]")
        
        # 提取数值 (换行符前的内容，并移除星号)
        coef_part <- str_split(cell_str, "\n")[[1]][1]
        value_clean <- str_remove_all(coef_part, "[\\+\\*]")
        value <- as.numeric(value_clean)
        
        # 如果转换失败（非数字），返回 0 或 NA
        if (is.na(value)) return(list(value = 0, is_sig = FALSE))
        
        return(list(value = value, is_sig = is_sig))
      }
      
      # 2. 辅助函数：绘制三维交互图 (四条线)
      generate_3way_plot <- function(s_z0_wmin, s_z0_wmax, s_z1_wmin, s_z1_wmax,
                                     z_main_effect, w_main_effect,
                                     x_label, w_label, y_label, title_suffix, filename) {
        
        # 定义 X 轴范围 (-1SD 到 +1SD)
        x_vals <- c(-1, 1)
        
        # --- 计算截距 (Intercepts) ---
        # 逻辑说明：
        # 模型方程简化版：Y = b0 + b2*W + b3*Z + ... (省略交互项对截距的微小修正，聚焦主效应层级)
        # 假设 Baseline (Z=0, W=0) 的截距归一化为 0
        
        # 1. Z=0 (Low EDU), W=Low (-1)
        # Intercept = 0 + (-1 * w_main_effect)
        b0_z0_wmin <- 0 - w_main_effect
        y_z0_wmin <- c(b0_z0_wmin + s_z0_wmin * -1, b0_z0_wmin + s_z0_wmin * 1)
        
        # 2. Z=0 (Low EDU), W=High (1)
        # Intercept = 0 + (1 * w_main_effect)
        b0_z0_wmax <- 0 + w_main_effect
        y_z0_wmax <- c(b0_z0_wmax + s_z0_wmax * -1, b0_z0_wmax + s_z0_wmax * 1)
        
        # 3. Z=1 (High EDU), W=Low (-1)
        # Intercept = z_main_effect + (-1 * w_main_effect)
        b0_z1_wmin <- z_main_effect - w_main_effect
        y_z1_wmin <- c(b0_z1_wmin + s_z1_wmin * -1, b0_z1_wmin + s_z1_wmin * 1)
        
        # 4. Z=1 (High EDU), W=High (1)
        # Intercept = z_main_effect + (1 * w_main_effect)
        b0_z1_wmax <- z_main_effect + w_main_effect
        y_z1_wmax <- c(b0_z1_wmax + s_z1_wmax * -1, b0_z1_wmax + s_z1_wmax * 1)
        
        # --- 构建绘图数据框 ---
        # 动态生成标签
        labels <- c(
          paste0("Z=0, W=Low ", w_label),
          paste0("Z=0, W=High ", w_label),
          paste0("Z=1, W=Low ", w_label),
          paste0("Z=1, W=High ", w_label)
        )
        
        plot_data <- data.frame(
          x = rep(x_vals, 4),
          y = c(y_z0_wmin, y_z0_wmax, y_z1_wmin, y_z1_wmax),
          Condition = rep(labels, each = 2)
        )
        
        # 设定因子水平以保证图例顺序
        plot_data$Condition <- factor(plot_data$Condition, levels = labels)
        
        # ── 颜色和线型映射 ────────────────────────────────
        # Z=0 (EDU Low) -> 蓝色系
        # Z=1 (EDU High) -> 红色系
        color_values <- setNames(
          c("#A6CEE3", "#1F78B4", "#FB9A99", "#E31A1C"),
          labels
        )
        
        # Low W -> 实线
        # High W -> 长虚线
        linetype_values <- setNames(
          c("solid", "longdash", "solid", "longdash"),
          labels
        )
        
        # --- 绘图 ---
        p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Condition, linetype = Condition)) +
          geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
          geom_point(size = 3) +
          
          scale_color_manual(values = color_values) +
          scale_linetype_manual(values = linetype_values) +
          
          labs(
            x = x_label,
            y = y_label
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme_bw() +
          theme(
            legend.title = element_blank(),
            legend.position = "inside",
            legend.position.inside = c(.95, .95),
            legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
            legend.box.just = "right",
            legend.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            panel.grid = element_blank()
          )
        
        ggsave(filename, plot = p, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
        message(paste(" -> Saved 3-way plot:", filename))
      }
      
      # 3. 主循环
      data_list <- list(
        type12_i2i1 = model.result.type12_i2i1,
        type12_i2s1 = model.result.type12_i2s1,
        type12_s2i1 = model.result.type12_s2i1,
        type12_s2s1 = model.result.type12_s2s1
      )
      
      for (name in names(data_list)) {
        df <- data_list[[name]]
        message(paste("Processing Dataset:", name))
        
        # --- 内部函数：获取指定单元格的值 ---
        get_val <- function(var_name, col_name) {
          row <- df %>% filter(predictor.var == var_name)
          if (nrow(row) == 0) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE))
          
          cell_str <- row[[col_name]]
          if (is.na(cell_str)) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE))
          
          return(parse_cell(cell_str))
        }
        
        # --- 内部函数：获取主效应数值（找不到返回0）---
        get_main_effect_val <- function(row_df, col_name) {
          if (nrow(row_df) == 0) return(0)
          # 取第一行匹配结果（如果有多个）
          cell_str <- row_df[[col_name]][1] 
          if (is.na(cell_str)) return(0)
          
          val <- parse_cell(cell_str)$value
          if (is.na(val)) return(0)
          return(val)
        }
        
        cols_to_check <- c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")
        x_label_suffix <- toupper(str_sub(name, -2, -1)) # 例如 I1
        w_label_suffix <- toupper(str_sub(name, -4, -3)) # 例如 I2
        
        filename_prefix <- file.path(here("interge_rela", 
                                          "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22"))
        
        # 1. 查找调节变量 Z (EDU) 的主效应行
        # 使用正则 ^EDU 匹配以 EDU 开头的变量名（如 EDU12）
        zmain_row <- df %>% filter(str_detect(predictor.var, "^EDU"))
        
        # 2. 查找调节变量 W (根据文件名推断, 如 I2, S2) 的主效应行
        # 优先精确匹配，如果找不到则尝试前缀匹配
        wmain_row <- df %>% filter(predictor.var == w_label_suffix)
        if(nrow(wmain_row) == 0) {
          wmain_row <- df %>% filter(str_starts(predictor.var, w_label_suffix))
        }
        
        for (col in cols_to_check) {
          col_label <- ifelse(col == "I5.ON", "I5 (Intercept)", "S5 (Slope)")
          y_lab_simple <- str_split(col_label, " ")[[1]][1] 
          
          # 获取主效应的具体数值 (针对当前是 I5 还是 S5 列)
          z_eff <- get_main_effect_val(zmain_row, col)
          w_eff <- get_main_effect_val(wmain_row, col)
          
          # 核心判定：仅检查三阶交互 XWZ_INT 是否显著 (p < 0.1)
          xwz_res <- get_val("XWZ_INT", col)
          
          if (xwz_res$is_sig) {
            message(paste0(" [", col_label, "] Found Significant 3-Way Interaction. Z_Main=", z_eff, ", W_Main=", w_eff))
            
            # 提取简单斜率
            slope_z0_min <- get_val("X0MIN", col)$value
            slope_z0_max <- get_val("X0MAX", col)$value
            slope_z1_min <- get_val("X1MIN", col)$value
            slope_z1_max <- get_val("X1MAX", col)$value
            
            # 检查是否有缺失值 (防错)
            if (any(is.na(c(slope_z0_min, slope_z0_max, slope_z1_min, slope_z1_max)))) {
              message(" -> Warning: Missing slope values. Skipping plot.")
              next
            }
            
            # 生成 SVG 图片
            generate_3way_plot(
              s_z0_wmin = slope_z0_min,
              s_z0_wmax = slope_z0_max,
              s_z1_wmin = slope_z1_min,
              s_z1_wmax = slope_z1_max,
              z_main_effect = z_eff,  # 传入 EDU 主效应
              w_main_effect = w_eff,  # 传入 I2/S2 主效应
              x_label = x_label_suffix,
              w_label = w_label_suffix,
              y_label = y_lab_simple,
              title_suffix = paste0("3-Way Interaction: ", name, " on ", y_lab_simple),
              filename = paste0(filename_prefix, "/ThreeWay_Combined_EDU_", name, "_", y_lab_simple, ".svg")
            )
            
          } else {
            # message(paste0(" [", col_label, "] XWZ_INT not significant."))
          }
        }
      }
      
    }
    
    #### 分Z子图的简单斜率(参照Hayes 2022:354, 选用)
    {
      library(tidyverse)
      library(stringr)
      library(here)
      library(patchwork)   # 用于拼接图形
      library(grid)        # 用于生成共享轴标签的文本对象
      
      # 1. 辅助函数：解析单元格 (提取数值 + 是否显著 + 原始字符串)
      parse_cell <- function(cell_str) {
        if (length(cell_str) > 1) cell_str <- cell_str[1]
        if (is.na(cell_str)) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE, raw = NA))
        is_sig <- str_detect(cell_str, "[\\+\\*]")
        coef_part <- str_split(cell_str, "\n")[[1]][1]
        value_clean <- str_remove_all(coef_part, "[\\+\\*]")
        value <- as.numeric(value_clean)
        if (is.na(value)) return(list(value = 0, is_sig = FALSE, raw = coef_part))
        return(list(value = value, is_sig = is_sig, raw = coef_part))
      }
      
      # 2. 生成标签文本 (如 b = -0.304***)
      get_label_text <- function(raw_str) {
        if (is.na(raw_str)) return("")
        return(paste0("b = ", raw_str))
      }
      
      # 3. 获取自定义轴标签
      get_axis_label <- function(code, type = "x") {
        if (type == "x") {
          labels <- c(
            "I1" = "ICE Mean Intercept(I1)",
            "S1" = "ICE Mean Slope(S1)",
            "I2" = "ICE SD_diff Intercept(I2)",
            "S2" = "ICE SD_diff Slope(S2)",
            "I3" = "ICE Gender_diff Intercept(I3)",
            "S3" = "ICE Gender_diff Slope(S3)",
            "I4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Intercept(I4)",
            "S4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Slope(S4)"
          )
          if (code %in% names(labels)) return(labels[[code]])
          return(code)
        } else {
          labels <- c(
            "I5" = "Depression Intercept(I5)",
            "S5" = "Depression Slope(S5)"
          )
          if (code %in% names(labels)) return(labels[[code]])
          return(code)
        }
      }
      
      # 4. 获取图例标签（<Med 和 >Med）
      get_legend_labels <- function(w_label) {
        w_names <- c(
          "I1" = "ICE Mean Intercept(I1)",
          "S1" = "ICE Mean Slope(S1)",
          "I2" = "ICE SD_diff Intercept(I2)",
          "S2" = "ICE SD_diff Slope(S2)",
          "I3" = "ICE Gender_diff Intercept(I3)",
          "S3" = "ICE Gender_diff Slope(S3)",
          "I4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Intercept(I4)",
          "S4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Slope(S4)"
        )
        base_name <- if (w_label %in% names(w_names)) w_names[[w_label]] else w_label
        return(c(paste0(base_name, "<Med"), paste0(base_name, ">Med")))
      }
      
      # 5. 生成单个子图的函数（新增 y_limits 参数来统一 y 轴范围）
      generate_subplot <- function(slope_min_val, slope_min_raw,
                                   slope_max_val, slope_max_raw,
                                   intercept_base,
                                   x_lab, y_lab,
                                   legend_labels,
                                   subtitle_text,
                                   is_bottom = FALSE,
                                   y_limits) {
        
        x_vals <- c(-1, 1)
        
        y_low  <- c(intercept_base$low  + slope_min_val * -1,
                    intercept_base$low  + slope_min_val *  1)
        y_high <- c(intercept_base$high + slope_max_val * -1,
                    intercept_base$high + slope_max_val *  1)
        
        plot_data <- data.frame(
          x = rep(x_vals, 2),
          y = c(y_low, y_high),
          Condition = rep(legend_labels, each = 2)
        )
        plot_data$Condition <- factor(plot_data$Condition, levels = legend_labels)
        
        label_data <- data.frame(
          x = c(-0.5, 0.5),
          y = c(intercept_base$low + slope_min_val * -0.5, 
                intercept_base$high + slope_max_val * 0.5),
          Condition = factor(legend_labels, levels = legend_labels),
          Label = c(get_label_text(slope_min_raw), get_label_text(slope_max_raw))
        )
        
        colors    <- setNames(c("#377EB8", "#E41A1C"), legend_labels)
        linetypes <- setNames(c("solid", "longdash"), legend_labels)
        
        p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Condition, linetype = Condition)) +
          geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
          geom_point(size = 3) +
          
          geom_label(
            data = label_data, aes(label = Label),
            size = 3, fill = "white", label.size = 0, alpha = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE
          ) +
          
          annotate(
            "label", x = 0, y = Inf, label = subtitle_text,
            vjust = 1.2, fill = "white", alpha = 0.6, label.size = 0, fontface = "bold"
          ) +
          
          scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
          scale_linetype_manual(values = linetypes) +
          
          labs(
            x = if(is_bottom) x_lab else NULL,
            y = NULL
          ) +
          
          # 统一 y 轴范围
          ylim(y_limits) +
          
          theme_minimal() +
          theme_bw() +
          theme(
            legend.position = "none",
            panel.grid       = element_blank(),
            axis.title.x     = if(!is_bottom) element_blank() else element_text(margin = margin(t = 0,b=0)),
            axis.title.y     = element_blank(),
            plot.margin      = if(is_bottom) margin(t = 2, r = 5, b = -2, l = 5) 
            else margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 2, l = 5)
          )
        
        return(p)
      }
      
      # 6. 核心函数：生成并保存组合图（统一 y 范围 + 共享 x 轴）
      generate_3way_plot_combined <- function(z0_slopes, z1_slopes,
                                              z_main, w_main,
                                              x_code, w_code, y_code,
                                              filename) {
        
        x_lab <- get_axis_label(x_code, "x")
        y_lab <- get_axis_label(y_code, "y")
        legend_labs <- get_legend_labels(w_code)
        
        # 计算所有可能的 y 值，用于自动确定统一的 y 范围
        z0_int_low  <- 0 - w_main
        z0_int_high <- 0 + w_main
        z1_int_low  <- z_main - w_main
        z1_int_high <- z_main + w_main
        
        y_values <- c(
          z0_int_low  + z0_slopes$min_val * c(-1, 1),
          z0_int_low  + z0_slopes$max_val * c(-1, 1),
          z0_int_high + z0_slopes$min_val * c(-1, 1),
          z0_int_high + z0_slopes$max_val * c(-1, 1),
          
          z1_int_low  + z1_slopes$min_val * c(-1, 1),
          z1_int_low  + z1_slopes$max_val * c(-1, 1),
          z1_int_high + z1_slopes$min_val * c(-1, 1),
          z1_int_high + z1_slopes$max_val * c(-1, 1)
        )
        
        y_min <- min(y_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        y_max <- max(y_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        y_range <- y_max - y_min
        # 增加 10% 缓冲（可根据需要调整为 0.15 或固定值如 c(-10, 10)）
        y_limits <- c(y_min - 0.1 * y_range, y_max + 0.1 * y_range)
        
        # 生成上图 (Z=0)
        p_z0 <- generate_subplot(
          slope_min_val = z0_slopes$min_val, slope_min_raw = z0_slopes$min_raw,
          slope_max_val = z0_slopes$max_val, slope_max_raw = z0_slopes$max_raw,
          intercept_base = list(low = z0_int_low, high = z0_int_high),
          x_lab = x_lab, y_lab = y_lab,
          legend_labels = legend_labs,
          subtitle_text = "Low (EDU)",
          is_bottom = FALSE,
          y_limits = y_limits
        )
        
        # 生成下图 (Z=1)
        p_z1 <- generate_subplot(
          slope_min_val = z1_slopes$min_val, slope_min_raw = z1_slopes$min_raw,
          slope_max_val = z1_slopes$max_val, slope_max_raw = z1_slopes$max_raw,
          intercept_base = list(low = z1_int_low, high = z1_int_high),
          x_lab = x_lab, y_lab = y_lab,
          legend_labels = legend_labs,
          subtitle_text = "High (EDU)",
          is_bottom = TRUE,
          y_limits = y_limits
        )
        
        # 共享的 Y 轴标签
        y_grob <- grid::textGrob(y_lab, rot = 90, gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 11))
        
        # 拼接两个子图 + 共享 x 轴刻度与标题
        plots_stacked <- (p_z0 / p_z1) +
          plot_layout(
            guides = "collect",
            axes = "collect",           # 共享轴（刻度、线等）
            axis_titles = "collect"     # x 轴标题只显示一次（在底部）
          ) &
          theme(
            legend.position = "top",
            legend.title = element_blank(),
            legend.margin     = margin(t = -10, b = 0),     # 向上拉近
            legend.box.margin = margin(t = -5, b = 2),
            legend.box.spacing = unit(0.15, "cm"),
            plot.margin       = margin(t = 2, r = 8, b = 0, l = 8)
          )
        
        # 左侧添加共享 Y 标签
        combined_plot <- wrap_elements(y_grob) + plots_stacked +
          plot_layout(widths = c(0.6, 25))
        
        # 确保输出目录存在
        dir_name <- dirname(filename)
        if (!dir.exists(dir_name)) dir.create(dir_name, recursive = TRUE)
        
        # 保存（高度已调紧凑）
        ggsave(filename, plot = combined_plot, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
        message(paste(" -> Saved Combined 3-way plot:", filename))
      }
      
      # 7. 主循环部分（处理多个数据集）
      data_list <- list(
        type12_i2i1 = model.result.type12_i2i1,
        type12_i2s1 = model.result.type12_i2s1,
        type12_s2i1 = model.result.type12_s2i1,
        type12_s2s1 = model.result.type12_s2s1
      )
      
      for (name in names(data_list)) {
        df <- data_list[[name]]
        message(paste("Processing Dataset:", name))
        
        get_val <- function(var_name, col_name) {
          row <- df %>% filter(predictor.var == var_name)
          if (nrow(row) == 0) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE, raw = NA))
          cell_str <- row[[col_name]]
          return(parse_cell(cell_str))
        }
        
        get_main_effect_val <- function(row_df, col_name) {
          if (nrow(row_df) == 0) return(0)
          val <- parse_cell(row_df[[col_name]][1])$value
          if (is.na(val)) return(0)
          return(val)
        }
        
        cols_to_check <- c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")
        x_code_suffix <- toupper(str_sub(name, -2, -1))
        w_code_suffix <- toupper(str_sub(name, -4, -3))
        
        filename_prefix <- file.path(here("interge_rela",
                                          "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22"))
        
        zmain_row <- df %>% filter(str_detect(predictor.var, "^EDU"))
        wmain_row <- df %>% filter(predictor.var == w_code_suffix)
        if (nrow(wmain_row) == 0) {
          wmain_row <- df %>% filter(str_starts(predictor.var, w_code_suffix))
        }
        
        for (col in cols_to_check) {
          y_code <- ifelse(col == "I5.ON", "I5", "S5")
          
          xwz_res <- get_val("XWZ_INT", col)
          
          if (xwz_res$is_sig) {
            message(paste0(" [", col, "] Found Significant 3-Way Interaction."))
            
            x0min <- get_val("X0MIN", col)
            x0max <- get_val("X0MAX", col)
            x1min <- get_val("X1MIN", col)
            x1max <- get_val("X1MAX", col)
            
            z_eff <- get_main_effect_val(zmain_row, col)
            w_eff <- get_main_effect_val(wmain_row, col)
            
            if (is.na(x0min$value) || is.na(x1min$value)) {
              message(" -> Warning: Missing slope values. Skipping.")
              next
            }
            
            z0_data <- list(min_val = x0min$value, min_raw = x0min$raw, 
                            max_val = x0max$value, max_raw = x0max$raw)
            z1_data <- list(min_val = x1min$value, min_raw = x1min$raw, 
                            max_val = x1max$value, max_raw = x1max$raw)
            
            generate_3way_plot_combined(
              z0_slopes = z0_data,
              z1_slopes = z1_data,
              z_main = z_eff, w_main = w_eff,
              x_code = x_code_suffix,
              w_code = w_code_suffix,
              y_code = y_code,
              filename = paste0(filename_prefix, "/ThreeWay_Facet_EDU_", name, "_", y_code, ".svg")
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }

    # depression

      # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
      model.result.type12_i2i1 <- output.cesd8.type12_i2i1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),

            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
            # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
            # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
            # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
            # W=0
            str_detect(param, "^(W)") & str_detect(param, "(0)$") ~ "XW0",
            str_detect(param, "0MIN$") ~ "X0MIN",
            str_detect(param, "0LO$") ~ "X0LO",
            str_detect(param, "0MOD$") ~ "X0MOD",
            str_detect(param, "0HI$") ~ "X0HI",

            str_detect(param, "1HI$") ~ "X1HI",
            str_detect(param, "1MAX$") ~ "X1MAX",
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>%

          sort_group = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S1") ~ 1,
            predictor.var %in% c("I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,      
            predictor.var %in% c("URBAN12") ~ 3,
            # predictor.var %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
            # predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
            # predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
            # predictor.var %in% c("S2S1_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT") ~ 7
            predictor.var %in% c("XW_INT","XZ_INT","WZ_INT","XWZ_INT") ~ 4,
            predictor.var %in% c("XW0","XW1") ~ 5,
            predictor.var %in% c("X0MIN","X0LO","X0MOD","X0HI","X0MAX") ~ 6,        
            predictor.var %in% c("X1MIN","X1LO","X1MOD","X1HI","X1MAX") ~ 7,
          )
        ) %>% 
        # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
        arrange(sort_group) %>%

      # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square

            predictor.var == "Intercepts" ~ "Means",
            predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
            TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
          ))

          ),
          sig = case_when(

            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(",

        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>%

          # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT

      ### i2i1
      # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
      model.result.type12_i2i1 <- output.cesd8.type12_i2i1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"

            # W=0
            str_detect(param, "^(W)") & str_detect(param, "(0)$") ~ "XW0",
            str_detect(param, "0MIN$") ~ "X0MIN",
            str_detect(param, "0LO$") ~ "X0LO",
            str_detect(param, "0MOD$") ~ "X0MOD",
            str_detect(param, "0HI$") ~ "X0HI",
            str_detect(param, "0MAX$") ~ "X0MAX",
            # W=1
            str_detect(param, "^(W)") & str_detect(param, "(1)$") ~ "XW1",
            str_detect(param, "1MIN$") ~ "X1MIN",
            str_detect(param, "1LO$") ~ "X1LO",
            str_detect(param, "1MOD$") ~ "X1MOD",
            str_detect(param, "1HI$") ~ "X1HI",
            str_detect(param, "1MAX$") ~ "X1MAX",
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>%

          sort_group = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S1") ~ 1,
            predictor.var %in% c("I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,

            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
            # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
            # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
            # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
            # W=0
            str_detect(param, "^(W)") & str_detect(param, "(0)$") ~ "XW0",
            str_detect(param, "0MIN$") ~ "X0MIN",
            str_detect(param, "0LO$") ~ "X0LO",
            str_detect(param, "0MOD$") ~ "X0MOD",
            str_detect(param, "0HI$") ~ "X0HI",
            str_detect(param, "0MAX$") ~ "X0MAX",
            # W=1
            str_detect(param, "^(W)") & str_detect(param, "(1)$") ~ "XW1",
            str_detect(param, "1MIN$") ~ "X1MIN",
            str_detect(param, "1LO$") ~ "X1LO",
            str_detect(param, "1MOD$") ~ "X1MOD",
            str_detect(param, "1HI$") ~ "X1HI",
            str_detect(param, "1MAX$") ~ "X1MAX",
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
        mutate(
          # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
          sort_group = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S1") ~ 1,
            predictor.var %in% c("I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,     
            predictor.var %in% c("PINC412") ~ 3,
            # predictor.var %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
            # predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
            # predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
            # predictor.var %in% c("S2S1_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT") ~ 7

            predictor.var %in% c("XW0","XW1") ~ 5,
            predictor.var %in% c("X0MIN","X0LO","X0MOD","X0HI","X0MAX") ~ 6,        
            predictor.var %in% c("X1MIN","X1LO","X1MOD","X1HI","X1MAX") ~ 7,
          )
        ) %>% 
        # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
        arrange(sort_group) %>% 
        select(-sort_group)
      
      
      # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
      r2 <- output.cesd8.type12_s2s1[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
      I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
      S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]

!  = iY + (b1 + b4W + b5Z + b7WZ)*X + b2W + b3Z + b6WZ + eY
!  = iY + (b1 + b5Z) * X + (b4 + b7Z) W * X + b2W + b3Z + b6WZ + eY

! Range of W value
!
! min_wi = ({wvalue_i3_min})   max_wi = ({wvalue_i3_max})
! min_ws = ({wvalue_s3_min})   max_ws = ({wvalue_s3_max})

NEW( min_w max_w lo_z hi_z );

min_w = ({wvalue_s3_min});
!lo_w = w_mean - sqrt(w_var);   ! -1 SD below mean of W
!med_w = w_mean;   ! mean of W
!hi_w = w_mean + sqrt(w_var);   ! +1 SD below mean of W

lo_z = 0;   ! low of Z
hi_z = 1;   ! high of Z

       

!!!!! XW_int→Y = (b4 + b7Z) W * X
!*
!!! i on i * i

wiii0 = b4i + b7i*lo_z;
wiii1 = b4i + b7i*hi_z;

!!! s on i * i
NEW (wiis0 wiis1);
wiis0 = b4s + b7s*lo_z;
wiis1 = b4s + b7s*hi_z;
*!
!!! s on i * s

wsss1 = b4s + b7s*hi_z;

!  = iY + (b1 + b4W + b5Z + b7WZ)*X + b2W + b3Z + b6WZ + eY
!  = iY + (b1 + b5Z) * X + (b4 + b7Z) W * X + b2W + b3Z + b6WZ + eY

! Range of W value
!
! min_wi = ({wvalue_i3_min})   max_wi = ({wvalue_i3_max})
! min_ws = ({wvalue_s3_min})   max_ws = ({wvalue_s3_max})

NEW( min_w max_w lo_z hi_z );

min_w = ({wvalue_i3_min});
!lo_w = w_mean - sqrt(w_var);   ! -1 SD below mean of W
!med_w = w_mean;   ! mean of W
!hi_w = w_mean + sqrt(w_var);   ! +1 SD below mean of W

lo_z = 0;   ! low of Z
hi_z = 1;   ! high of Z

       

!!!!! XW_int→Y = (b4 + b7Z) W * X

!!! i on i * i

wiii0 = b4i + b7i*lo_z;
wiii1 = b4i + b7i*hi_z;

!!! s on i * i

wiis0 = b4s + b7s*lo_z;
wiis1 = b4s + b7s*hi_z;
!*

wiss1 = b4s + b7s*hi_z;

wsis1 = b4s + b7s*hi_z;

wsss1 = b4s + b7s*hi_z;

      model.result.type13_i2i1 <- output.cesd8.type13_i2i1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",

            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),

            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",

            str_detect(param, "0MOD$") ~ "X0MOD",

            str_detect(param, "1MAX$") ~ "X1MAX",
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),

            predictor.var %in% c("S1") ~ 1,

            str_detect(param, "0MAX$") ~ "X0MAX",
            # W=1
            str_detect(param, "^(W)") & str_detect(param, "(1)$") ~ "XW1",
            str_detect(param, "1MIN$") ~ "X1MIN",
            str_detect(param, "1LO$") ~ "X1LO",
            str_detect(param, "1MOD$") ~ "X1MOD",
            str_detect(param, "1HI$") ~ "X1HI",
            str_detect(param, "1MAX$") ~ "X1MAX",
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
        mutate(
          # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
          sort_group = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S1") ~ 1,
            predictor.var %in% c("I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,        
            predictor.var %in% c("SEX12") ~ 3,

            # predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
            # predictor.var %in% c("S2S1_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT") ~ 7
            predictor.var %in% c("XW_INT","XZ_INT","WZ_INT","XWZ_INT") ~ 4,
            predictor.var %in% c("XW0","XW1") ~ 5,
            predictor.var %in% c("X0MIN","X0LO","X0MOD","X0HI","X0MAX") ~ 6,        
            predictor.var %in% c("X1MIN","X1LO","X1MOD","X1HI","X1MAX") ~ 7,
          )
        ) %>% 
        # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
        arrange(sort_group) %>% 
        select(-sort_group)
      
      
      # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
      r2 <- output.cesd8.type13_s2s1[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
      I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
      S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]

            predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
            TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
          ))

      model.result.type13_i2i1 <- output.cesd8.type13_i2i1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",

            str_detect(param, "0MIN$") ~ "X0MIN",
            str_detect(param, "0LO$") ~ "X0LO",
            str_detect(param, "0MOD$") ~ "X0MOD",

            str_detect(param, "1HI$") ~ "X1HI",
            str_detect(param, "1MAX$") ~ "X1MAX",
            TRUE ~ param
          ),

            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),

            predictor.var %in% c("S1") ~ 1,

            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
            # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
            # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
            # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
            # W=0
            str_detect(param, "^(W)") & str_detect(param, "(0)$") ~ "XW0",
            str_detect(param, "0MIN$") ~ "X0MIN",
            str_detect(param, "0LO$") ~ "X0LO",
            str_detect(param, "0MOD$") ~ "X0MOD",
            str_detect(param, "0HI$") ~ "X0HI",
            str_detect(param, "0MAX$") ~ "X0MAX",
            # W=1
            str_detect(param, "^(W)") & str_detect(param, "(1)$") ~ "XW1",
            str_detect(param, "1MIN$") ~ "X1MIN",
            str_detect(param, "1LO$") ~ "X1LO",
            str_detect(param, "1MOD$") ~ "X1MOD",
            str_detect(param, "1HI$") ~ "X1HI",
            str_detect(param, "1MAX$") ~ "X1MAX",
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
        mutate(
          # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
          sort_group = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S1") ~ 1,
            predictor.var %in% c("I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,      
            predictor.var %in% c("URBAN12") ~ 3,
            # predictor.var %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
            # predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
            # predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
            # predictor.var %in% c("S2S1_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT") ~ 7
            predictor.var %in% c("XW_INT","XZ_INT","WZ_INT","XWZ_INT") ~ 4,
            predictor.var %in% c("XW0","XW1") ~ 5,
            predictor.var %in% c("X0MIN","X0LO","X0MOD","X0HI","X0MAX") ~ 6,        
            predictor.var %in% c("X1MIN","X1LO","X1MOD","X1HI","X1MAX") ~ 7,
          )
        ) %>% 
        # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
        arrange(sort_group) %>% 
        select(-sort_group)
      
      
      # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
      r2 <- output.cesd8.type13_s2s1[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
      I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
      S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]
      
      # 3. 提取模型拟合指数
      summaries <- output.cesd8.type13_s2s1[["summaries"]]
      AIC <- summaries$AIC_Mean[1]
      BIC <- summaries$BIC_Mean[1]
      CFI <- summaries$CFI_Mean[1]
      TLI <- summaries$TLI_Mean[1]
      RMSEA <- summaries$RMSEA_Mean[1]

      model.fit_text.type1 <- paste0("AIC=", sprintf("%.2f", AIC), 
                                     ",\n BIC=", sprintf("%.2f", BIC))
      
      # 5. 添加 Pseudo-R² 行和 Model fit index 行
      model.result.type13_s2s1 <- model.result.type13_s2s1 %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Pseudo-R²",

          S5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", S5_r2)
        ) %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Model fit index",
          I5.ON = model.fit_text.type1,
          S5.ON = model.fit_text.type1
        ) %>% 
        mutate(
          predictor.var.common = case_when(
            # predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ "Intercept",
            # predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4") ~ "Slope",

            # predictor.var %in% c("S1SX_INT","S2SX_INT","S3SX_INT","S4SX_INT") ~ "SEX × Slope",
            predictor.var == "Intercepts" ~ "Means",
            predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
            TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
          ))
      
      model.result.type13_s2s1  
      
      
      
      
      
      model.result.type13_i2i1
      model.result.type13_i2s1

      model.result.type13_s2s1
      
      
      ##### 合并所有结果表
      # 按predictor.var列合并所有结果到一个数据框
      library(dplyr)

          by = "predictor.var.common"
        ) %>% 
        mutate(

            predictor.var.common %in% c("I1") ~ 0,
            predictor.var.common %in% c("S1") ~ 1,
            predictor.var.common %in% c("I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 2,
            predictor.var.common %in% c("S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 3,       
            predictor.var.common %in% c("URBAN12") ~ 3,  
            # predictor.var.common %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
            # predictor.var.common %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,

            # predictor.var.common %in% c("MIN","LO","MOD","HI","MAX") ~ 9
            predictor.var.common %in% c("XW_INT","XZ_INT","WZ_INT") ~ 4,
            predictor.var.common %in% c("XWZ_INT") ~ 5,
            predictor.var.common %in% c("XW0","XW1") ~ 6,
            predictor.var.common %in% c("X0MIN","X0LO","X0MOD","X0HI","X0MAX") ~ 7,        
            predictor.var.common %in% c("X1MIN","X1LO","X1MOD","X1HI","X1MAX") ~ 8,

      model.result.type13_all

        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",

            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",

          )
        ) %>% 
        # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
        arrange(sort_group) %>% 
        select(-sort_group)

      ## s2s1

      ##### 制表模型结果
      ### i2i1
      # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
      model.result.type14_i2i1 <- output.cesd8.type14_i2i1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"

            # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
            # W=0
            str_detect(param, "^(W)") & str_detect(param, "(0)$") ~ "XW0",
            str_detect(param, "0MIN$") ~ "X0MIN",
            str_detect(param, "0LO$") ~ "X0LO",
            str_detect(param, "0MOD$") ~ "X0MOD",
            str_detect(param, "0HI$") ~ "X0HI",
            str_detect(param, "0MAX$") ~ "X0MAX",
            # W=1
            str_detect(param, "^(W)") & str_detect(param, "(1)$") ~ "XW1",
            str_detect(param, "1MIN$") ~ "X1MIN",
            str_detect(param, "1LO$") ~ "X1LO",
            str_detect(param, "1MOD$") ~ "X1MOD",
            str_detect(param, "1HI$") ~ "X1HI",
            str_detect(param, "1MAX$") ~ "X1MAX",
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
        mutate(
          # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
          sort_group = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S1") ~ 1,
            predictor.var %in% c("I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,

          )
        ) %>% 
        # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
        arrange(sort_group) %>% 
        select(-sort_group)
      
      
      # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square

            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
            # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
            # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
            # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
            # W=0
            str_detect(param, "^(W)") & str_detect(param, "(0)$") ~ "XW0",
            str_detect(param, "0MIN$") ~ "X0MIN",
            str_detect(param, "0LO$") ~ "X0LO",
            str_detect(param, "0MOD$") ~ "X0MOD",
            str_detect(param, "0HI$") ~ "X0HI",
            str_detect(param, "0MAX$") ~ "X0MAX",
            # W=1
            str_detect(param, "^(W)") & str_detect(param, "(1)$") ~ "XW1",
            str_detect(param, "1MIN$") ~ "X1MIN",
            str_detect(param, "1LO$") ~ "X1LO",
            str_detect(param, "1MOD$") ~ "X1MOD",
            str_detect(param, "1HI$") ~ "X1HI",
            str_detect(param, "1MAX$") ~ "X1MAX",
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
        mutate(
          # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
          sort_group = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S1") ~ 1,
            predictor.var %in% c("I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,   
            predictor.var %in% c("EDU12") ~ 3,   
            # predictor.var %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
            # predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
            # predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
            # predictor.var %in% c("S2S1_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT") ~ 7
            predictor.var %in% c("XW_INT","XZ_INT","WZ_INT","XWZ_INT") ~ 4,
            predictor.var %in% c("XW0","XW1") ~ 5,
            predictor.var %in% c("X0MIN","X0LO","X0MOD","X0HI","X0MAX") ~ 6,        
            predictor.var %in% c("X1MIN","X1LO","X1MOD","X1HI","X1MAX") ~ 7,
          )
        ) %>% 
        # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
        arrange(sort_group) %>% 
        select(-sort_group)
      
      
      # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
      r2 <- output.cesd8.type14_s2s1[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
      I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
      S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]
      
      # 3. 提取模型拟合指数
      summaries <- output.cesd8.type14_s2s1[["summaries"]]
      AIC <- summaries$AIC_Mean[1]
      BIC <- summaries$BIC_Mean[1]
      CFI <- summaries$CFI_Mean[1]
      TLI <- summaries$TLI_Mean[1]
      RMSEA <- summaries$RMSEA_Mean[1]

        add_row(

        ) %>%

          predictor.var.common = case_when(

            predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
            TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
          ))

      model.result.type14_i2i1

      ##### 合并所有结果表

          by = "predictor.var.common"

      ### i2i1
      # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
      model.result.type14_i2i1 <- output.cesd8.type14_i2i1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"

            # W=0
            str_detect(param, "^(W)") & str_detect(param, "(0)$") ~ "XW0",
            str_detect(param, "0MIN$") ~ "X0MIN",
            str_detect(param, "0LO$") ~ "X0LO",
            str_detect(param, "0MOD$") ~ "X0MOD",
            str_detect(param, "0HI$") ~ "X0HI",
            str_detect(param, "0MAX$") ~ "X0MAX",
            # W=1
            str_detect(param, "^(W)") & str_detect(param, "(1)$") ~ "XW1",
            str_detect(param, "1MIN$") ~ "X1MIN",
            str_detect(param, "1LO$") ~ "X1LO",
            str_detect(param, "1MOD$") ~ "X1MOD",
            str_detect(param, "1HI$") ~ "X1HI",
            str_detect(param, "1MAX$") ~ "X1MAX",
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>%

          sort_group = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S1") ~ 1,

            # predictor.var %in% c("SEX12") ~ "SEX",
            # predictor.var %in% c("I1SX_INT","I2SX_INT","I3SX_INT","I4SX_INT") ~ "SEX × Intercept",
            # predictor.var %in% c("S1SX_INT","S2SX_INT","S3SX_INT","S4SX_INT") ~ "SEX × Slope",
            predictor.var == "Intercepts" ~ "Means",
            predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
            TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
          ))
      
      model.result.type14_s2i1  
      
      
      
      
      
      
      ##### 制表模型结果
      ### s2s1
      # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
      model.result.type14_s2s1 <- output.cesd8.type14_s2s1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",

          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
            # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
